notes: Four taḥwīl branches of one saying. «كلهم عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد» joins the first three; the fourth («معتمر، عن إسماعيل») writes a bare «إسماعيل» (occurrence 2) for the same convergence.
The shared tail («قال سمعت قيسا، يروي عن أبي مسعود») is written once after the last taḥwīl and so belongs to all four branches.
«أبي» in the second branch is the father of Ibn Numayr, named only by relation (occurrence 2; occurrence 1 is in «ابن أبي شيبة»).
